title: The AI bubble could pop
transcript: Are you worried about the AI bubble popping? >> I've been through the internet bubble in 2002. I've been through the global financial crisis in 2008. Do you know what's always true? The person who shows up prepared always wins. You drop Richard Branson in Mongolia and you come back in 3 years, you know what you're going to find? >> He's going to be rich again. >> Winners win. Just become a guy that wins. If AI pops, you still win. I don't worry about the internet popping, AI [music] popping. Every time you said this, people have made money. I want to be the kind of person knows how to make money. >> Yeah. >> So, you're going to bet on you, Liam? >> Yeah. >> Great question.
